qualification.education_qualification: B.Voc/ Degree/ Diploma/ NTC/ NAC in relevant branch with CITS and relevant experience
qualification.details: Electronic Mechanic (CITS): B.Voc/ Degree in appropriate branch of Electronics Engineering from AICTE/ UGC recognized University with CITS OR 03 years Diploma in appropriate branch of Electronics Engineering from AICTE/ recognized Board/ Institution with CITS OR Ex-serviceman from Indian Armed forces with 15 years of service in related field as per equivalency through DGR with methods of instruction course of minimum 02 years OR NTC/ NAC passed in Electronics Mechanic trade with CITS. Experience: 02 years post CITS for Degree, 05 years for Diploma, 07 years for NTC/ NAC. Dress Making (CITS): B.Voc/ Degree in Costume Designing & Dress Making / Fashion Designing / Fashion Technology/ Apparel Technology / Garment Fabrication Technology from AICTE/ UGC recognized Board / University with CITS OR Diploma (Minimum 02 Years) in Costume Designing & Dress Making / Fashion Designing / Fashion Technology/ Apparel Technology / Garment Fabrication Technology from recognized Board/ University with CITS OR Ex-serviceman from Indian Armed forces with 15 years of service in related field as per equivalency through DGR with methods of instruction course of minimum 02 years OR NTC/ NAC passed in relevant trade with CITS. Experience: 02 years post CITS for Degree, 05 years for Diploma, 07 years for NTC/ NAC. CHNM (CITS): B.Voc/ Degree in relevant branches of Computer Science / IT/ Electronics Engineering from AICTE/ UGC recognized University, or NIELIT “B” with CITS OR Diploma (Minimum 2 Years) in appropriate branches of Computer Science / IT/ Electronics Engineering recognized Board/ University with CITS OR Ex-serviceman from Indian Armed forces with 15 years of service in related field as per equivalency through DGR with methods of instruction course of minimum 02 years OR NTC/ NAC passed in CHNM trade with CITS. Experience: 02 years post CITS for Degree, 05 years for Diploma, 07 years for NTC/ NAC. CSA (CITS): B.Voc/ Degree in Computer Science/ Information Technology or Post Graduate (Computer Science/ Computer Application/ Information Technology) or NIELIT “B" or equivalent from AICTE/ UGC recognized university / board with CITS OR 03 year Diploma in Computer Science/ Information Technology or PGDCA from recognized university/ board with CITS OR Ex-serviceman from Indian Armed forces with 15 years of service in related field as per equivalency through DGR with methods of instruction course of minimum 02 years OR NTC/ NAC passed in CSA trade with CITS. Experience: 02 years post CITS for Degree/ PG, 05 years for Diploma, 07 years for NTC/ NAC. MMV (CITS): B.Voc/ Degree in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering from AICTE/ UGC recognized University with CITS OR 03 years Diploma in Automobile or Mechanical from AICTE/ recognized Board/ University OR Ex-serviceman from Indian Armed forces with 15 years of service in related field as per equivalency through DGR with methods of instruction course of minimum 02 years OR NTC/ NAC in Mechanic Motor Vehicle. Experience: 02 years post CITS for Degree, 05 years for Diploma, 07 years for NTC/ NAC. Essential: Valid MCWG & LMV driving License. Welder (CITS): B.Voc./ Degree in Mechanical / Production Engineering from AICTE/ UGC recognized Board / University with CITS OR 05 years Diploma in Mechanical / Production/ Metallurgy/ Mechatronics Engineering from AICTE/ recognized Board/ University OR Ex-serviceman from Indian Armed forces with 15 years of service in related field as per equivalency through DGR with methods of instruction course of minimum 02 years OR NTC/ NAC in relevant trade. Experience: 02 years post CITS for Degree, 02 years for Diploma, 07 years for NTC/ NAC. Information Technology (CITS): B.Voc/ Degree in Engineering/ Technology in Computer Science / IT from AICTE/ UGC recognized University with CITS OR Computer Science / Computer Application / IT OR NIELIT “B” Level from AICTE/ UGC recognized university OR Bachelor in Computer Science / Computer Application / IT OR PGDCA from AICTE/ UGC recognized university OR NIELIT “A” Level OR Ex-serviceman from Indian Armed forces with 15 years of service in related field as per equivalency through DGR with methods of instruction course of minimum 05 years OR 03 Years Diploma in Engineering/ Technology in Computer Science / IT from AICTE/ recognized Board/ University or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT OR NTC/ NAC passed in the Information Technology trade. Experience: 02 years post CITS for Degree, 02 years for NIELIT B, 05 years for Bachelor/ PGDCA/ NIELIT A/ Diploma, 07 years for NTC/ NAC. Workshop Calculation & Science (CTS): B.Voc./ Degree in Engineering from AICTE/ UGC recognized Engineering College/ university with CITS OR 03 years Diploma in Engineering from AICTE / recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT with CITS OR NTC/ NAC in any Engineering trade with CITS OR NCIC in RODA or any of its variants under DGT. Experience: 01 year post CITS for Degree, 02 years for Diploma, 03 years for NTC/ NAC. Engineering Drawing (CTS): B.Voc./ Degree in Engineering from AICTE/ UGC recognized Engineering College/ university with CITS OR 03 years Diploma in Engineering from AICTE / recognized board of technical education or relevant Advanced Diploma (Vocational) from DGT with CITS OR NTC/ NAC in any Engineering trade with CITS OR NCIC in RODA or any of its variants under DGT. Experience: 01 year post CITS for Degree, 02 years for Diploma, 03 years for NTC/ NAC.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The National Skill Training Institute Kanpur (NSTI Kanpur) is conducting this recruitment drive for engaging temporary guest faculty members for various trades during the academic session.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The open position being offered through this employment notification is Guest Faculty across multiple technical trades and subjects under CITS and CTS frameworks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The final date for submitting the completed offline application form to the institute office is 05 October 2026 up to 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly in offline mode by post or hand delivery to the designated postal address provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for NSTI Kanpur Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Voc, Degree, Diploma, NTC, or NAC in the relevant branch along with a CITS certification and requisite practical experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants must be at least 21 years of age as calculated on 01 August 2026 to be eligible for consideration.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates teaching CITS courses will receive Rs. 250 per hour, while CTS course instructors get Rs. 200 per hour, subject to a monthly maximum of Rs. 30,000.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy for Guest Faculty has been notified, distributed across various specialized technical trades and engineering subjects.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be determined through a comprehensive evaluation process comprising a Written Test followed by a Skill Test.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Completed application forms along with all enclosures should be sent to “The Deputy Director/Training Incharge, National Skill Training Institute (NSTI), P.O-Udyog Nagar, Kanpur-208022”.
